specs.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production game UI character illustration with genuine alpha transparency, NOT a concept sheet or a screenshot. Image 1 is the APPROVED IDENTITY reference for NeonExorcist. Extract and preserve the main character's exact approved design, age, gender presentation, skin tone, face/hair or mask, armor, clothing, original neon color palette and their matching hoverboard. Do not use alternate small scene figures as a redesign. Produce ONE full-body character and ONE hoverboard only, in a calm, balanced, relaxed idle stance facing front three-quarter toward the viewer's right. Feet rest on the hoverboard, knees only slightly bent, shoulders at rest, both hands down loosely beside the thighs. No combat gesture, lunging, spell casting, raised arms or action energy. Preserve the fine concept-art detail: crisp fabric grain, natural dark material values, smooth high-quality skin/metal shading and clean colored neon seams without blown highlights. Keep the rainbow ski-goggle-style single shield covering eyes AND nose, black tied-up hair, compact black ninja shoes, fitted technical jacket, orange/yellow/cyan/pink accents, original sleek board.
Composition: a tall 2:3 portrait canvas, complete head/hair to shoes and whole hoverboard visible, centered, with 7% transparent margins on every side. The top of the head is near 8% image height, face centered near x50% / y16%, board around y86%. No tilt of the image plane. This will be drawn SMALL, around 180px tall in a neon menu, so preserve a clear silhouette and avoid wispy distracting effects. No floating talismans, holograms, digital spirits, shields, smoke, explosions or extra props around the body. Integrated clothing charms are retained. No ground, floor, scene, frame, text, name, labels, inset panels, diagrams, secondary views or watermark. The background must be truly transparent RGBA, never gray/black/white or a painted checkerboard. Controlled soft neutral studio light plus very subtle neon rim lighting. This is one reusable finished UI asset faithful to the approved character, not a new character concept.
